paper_title: Antenna Doping: The Key for Achieving Efficient Optical Wavelength Conversion in Crystalline Chromophoric Heterolayers

knowledge_points.content: The study utilizes three core-substituted naphthalenediimide (cNDI) linkers for a wavelength conversion cascade: bis-ethoxy-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-G) for green/blue absorption, ethoxy-cyclohexylamine-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-O) as an intermediate, and bis-cyclohexylamine-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-R) for red emission.
knowledge_points.evidence: The approach presented here is based on three complementary core-substituted naphthalenediimide-based linkers (cNDIs)... bis-ethoxy-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-G), ethoxy-cyclohexylamine-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-O), and bis-cyclohexylamine-naphthalenediimide (cNDI-R).

knowledge_points.content: The Zn-SURMOF-2 structure consists of ditopic dicarboxylate linkers connected to Zn++ ions forming paddle-wheel secondary building units in a 2D square-grid-like structure with P4 symmetry.
knowledge_points.evidence: The basic MOF type used for the present study is Zn-SURMOF-2. The key structural elements... are ditopic dicarboxylate linkers, which are connected to Zn++ ions yielding so-called paddle-wheels. These secondary building units then form 2D square-grid-like structures exhibiting a P4 symmetry.

knowledge_points.content: In neat chromophoric SURMOFs, Forster energy transport is highly anisotropic, being efficient parallel to the substrate due to J-aggregate coupling but approximately 1000 times lower in the direction perpendicular to the layers.
knowledge_points.evidence: As a result of this pronounced structural anisotropy, Forster energy transport is very efficient parallel to the substrate but very poor (lower by a factor of 1000) perpendicular to the layers.

knowledge_points.content: The 'antenna doping' strategy involves introducing a small percentage of energy acceptor linkers (e.g., 1.6% cNDI-O into a Zn-cNDI-G layer) to facilitate more isotropic energy coupling and enable interlayer transfer in crystalline heterostructures.
knowledge_points.evidence: We introduced dopants in the form of different MOF linkers with the same length... The bottom Zn-cNDI-G layer was doped with acceptor cNDI-O linkers... we chose 1.6% cNDI-O/Zn-cNDI-G as the bottom layer.

knowledge_points.content: A three-layer SURMOF heterostructure (HL-2) utilizing optimized antenna doping achieved an overall optical wavelength conversion efficiency of approximately 75%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Using optimized fabrication parameters and dopant concentrations, a three-layer, two-step cascade with an overall optical conversion efficiency of ≈75% is realized.

knowledge_points.content: The fluorescence quantum yield of the antenna-doped trilayer heterostructure (HL-2) reached approximately 10.5%, which is a fourfold increase compared to the individual pristine SURMOFs (e.g., 2.3% for Zn-cNDI-G).
knowledge_points.evidence: The fluorescence quantum yield of HL-2 was found to be ≈10.5 ± 1% which is higher than that for pristine Zn-cNDI-G (≈2.3 ± 0.5%) and Zn-cNDI-R (≈2.9 ± 0.4%).

knowledge_points.content: The chromophoric SURMOF thin films were fabricated using a layer-by-layer (lbl) spin-coating method on hydroxyl-terminated surfaces to ensure high crystallinity and [001] orientation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The stacked trilayer SURMOF system was deposited on hydroxyl-terminated surfaces using an lbl spincoating fabrication method... fabricated structurally well-defined Zn-SURMOF-2 thin films with [001] orientation.

knowledge_points.content: X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis confirmed that the three different chromophoric SURMOFs are isostructural, with linkers stacking along the [010] crystallographic direction and an inter-linker distance of 6.8 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) data revealed that the three SURMOFs were isostructural... with the cNDI-based linkers stacked along the [010] crystallographic direction... and an inter-linker distance of 6.8 Å.

knowledge_points.content: Long-range Forster resonance energy transfer (LR-FRET) in these doped MOF systems can occur over distances exceeding 10 nm, which is significantly farther than standard FRET processes.
knowledge_points.evidence: As expected for LR-FRET, the energy transfer occurs over rather far distances of >10 nm, which are substantially longer than those in normal FRET processes.

knowledge_points.content: The maintenance of identical unit cell parameters across different core-substituted NDI linkers is a critical requirement for successful heteroepitaxial growth of the trilayer SURMOF system.
knowledge_points.evidence: we thus conclude that the modification of the core substitution group in the NDI linkers did not alter the unit cell parameters of these chromophoric crystalline structures, a key requirement for achieving good heteroepitaxial growth.
